messages:
maya: Quick sync — setting up a cross-cloud data integration pilot with Snowflake (external tables) + Databricks Delta Live + Qdrant for vector storage. Goal: validate end-to-end latency and dev experience for customers who want in-place embeddings.

sam: Love it. Main questions: how do we handle Snowflake-to-embeds throughput? UDF vs export batch?

maya: Thinking export-first for initial pilot (COPY to s3 -> batch embeddings), then a proof-of-concept for Snowflake external functions / UDFs. Keep it simple for partner stakeholders.

liam: Curious about auth model. For private deployments customers will want VPC egress + KMS. Are partners okay with us pulling data or do they prefer push?

zoe: Partner ask from Databricks: they'd prefer push (jobs on their workspace) to avoid cross-account creds. We should provide sample job spec.

maya: I'll draft a Databricks job template. Sam can you mock the s3->embed batching script? Something like:
```bash
python batch_embed.py --source s3://my-bucket/stage --model open-compat --batch 512 --dest qdrant://collection
```

sam: yes, I have a quick prototype. Will post gist later. Also need to define data schema for vector upserts (id, metadata JSON, embedding float32 as base64).

partner-bot: @maya created pilot-brief doc: https://drive.redwood/test-pilot (auto)

zoe: For Qdrant we should measure upsert throughput and retrieval P99. Recommend we provision dedicated instance for pilot to avoid noisy neighbors.

liam: I'll reach out to infra to reserve a GPU node for embedding CPU fallback and dedicated qdrant size. ETA tomorrow.

maya: Coordinating announcement cadence with partners: no public marketing until partners sign off. Let's plan internal demo on Thu and partner walkthrough next week.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll add a checklist: infra, job template, embed code, qdrant sizing, telemetry (latency/cost), partner sign-off.

zoe: tagging legal for data processing consent? @jordan-legal can you advise on contract addendum for pilot?

maya: thanks all. next steps: sam + zoe pair on templates, liam on infra, maya will schedule demo. :rocket:
